# Tokytics

Tokytics is an LLM cost observability and proxy platform for tracking, controlling, and reducing AI spend across providers.

## Key pages
- [Overview](https://tokytics.com/)
- [Quickstart](https://tokytics.com/docs/quickstart)
- [LLM proxy](https://tokytics.com/features/llm-proxy)
- [Semantic caching](https://tokytics.com/features/semantic-caching)
- [Security](https://tokytics.com/security)
- [Pricing](https://tokytics.com/pricing)

## Best for
- LLM cost tracking
- LLM usage analytics
- Semantic caching
- Budget enforcement
- Multi-provider AI proxy
